# Designing Dose

> Designing Dose is a global full-service digital agency headquartered in Dublin, Ireland, with offices in Irvine CA (USA), Saskatoon (Canada), and Reading (UK). We deliver web design, SEO, social media marketing, mobile app development, logo design, video animation, illustration, and dropshipping store setup for small businesses, startups, and growing brands across Ireland, UK, USA, Canada, and Australia.

Prices are displayed in the visitor's local currency on the website — Euro for Ireland and Europe, Pound for UK, Dollar for USA, Canada, Australia and rest of world. The numerical value is the same across all currencies.
